title: Kalypso: Relational LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2607.23815v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as semantic operators for filtering, extracting, ranking, joining, and transforming unstructured data. Existing semantic query processing systems invoke request-centric LLM serving systems that are unaware of the query plan, leaving substantial performance opportunities unused. This paper introduces relational LLM serving, an abstraction that makes LLM serving aware of semantic query structure while preserving query semantics and output accuracy. The key opportunity is pipelined execution across semantic operators: when intermediate tuples flow directly from one operator to the next, their KV-cache state can be reused instead of recomputed.   We present Kalypso, a relational LLM serving system that exposes an API for semantic query plans and executes them using an adaptive, memory-aware scheduling algorithm. translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.23815v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：大型语言模型越来越多地被用作语义操作符，用于过滤、提取、排序、连接和转换非结构化数据。现有的语义查询处理系统调用以请求为中心的LLM服务系统，这些系统不了解查询计划，从而留下了大量性能优化的机会未被利用。本文引入了关系型LLM服务，这是一种抽象，使LLM服务能够感知语义查询结构，同时保持查询语义和输出准确性。关键机会在于跨语义操作符的流水线执行：当中间元组直接从一个操作符流向下一个操作符时，其KV缓存状态可以被重用，而不是重新计算。我们提出了Kalypso，一个关系型LLM服务系统，它提供了一个用于语义查询计划的API，并使用一种自适应、内存感知的调度算法来执行这些计划。Kalypso解决了一个新的在线调度问题，其中流水线操作符...
tldr: Kalypso通过让LLM服务感知查询计划并重用KV缓存状态，实现了跨语义操作符的流水线执行，显著提升了语义查询处理性能。
en_tdlr: Kalypso enables pipelined execution across semantic operators by making LLM serving aware of query plans and reusing KV cache states, significantly improving semantic query processing performance.
